mapping.meaning: both thighs leave for and hold one native MARCH frame; each held foot lands under that frame's hip, its sole posed flat (a native frame whose lowest sole-patch vertex is the boot minimum) on the seated plane y = 0; the last step starts at .88

notes: Heights are from the seated plane, model y = 0: Map3DUnitRig seats the figure origin there. The rendered ground is the seat lift below it, so penetration from y = 0 is the stricter reading.

Hover is the LOWEST vertex of the planted sole patch (bind-mesh boot vertices within 5 mm of that boot's lowest bind vertex): whether the sole touches. Slide is the ground-projected drift of that patch from touchdown, in the entry (world) frame of the helper's yaw convention.

Canonical hover 6620 um is native MARCH 25/28's own entry boot floor (the endpoint stance is the protected native pose). Witness hover <= 17209 um and penetration <= 1062 um are the frozen native endpoint boot minima (feasibility contract), not the mapping.
Imported playback: 289 Godot AnimationPlayer samples per clip (every key and every midpoint); sampling margin = max vertex speed x max gap / 2.

The witness solve is not committed (it is about 4x the canonical one); test_pivot_mapping.py re-audits the committed canonical solve. Rebuild the witness rows with pivot_mapping.py build --witness, pivot_solve.gd and audit.
This is clip acceptance, not LOCO-CERT-INF: the full turn/phase grid certificate stays with that step.
